text:
The eyes can be a great diagnostic window for your doctor to understand how your brain is functioning. You have a number of different eye movements your brain can make to help allow you to see your environment more effectively. Each type of eye movement is generated from different regions of the brain and converges to the same areas that eventually move your eyes. Performing eye movement testing and eye movement therapies gives clinicians unique ways to assess and treat patients with neurological disorders. 
A videonystagmography (VNG) or video-oculography (VOG) test uses a special set of goggles with a camera to record your eye movements. The goggles record how your eyes move in response to these different actions. During this test, examiners look at specific types of eye movements which can be seen in different vestibular and central nervous system disorders disorders. #brain #brainhealth #braintraining #braininjury #brainscience #neuroscience #neurology #functionalneurology #eyes #vestibularrehabilitation #dizziness #dizzinessrelief #concussion #concussionhope
